column3: Printing and name presentation, no game behavior here: Mind Flayer, the Shadow is another printing of this one Oracle card (the ruling is the note Wizards gives such pairs, as Baldin, Century Herdmaster's for "E. Honda, Sumo Champion", the same day); the card data has one Oracle card, named Arvinox, the Mind Flail, and no card or object can be named Mind Flayer, the Shadow, so every name check in a game sees one name (CR 201.6: a printing's other name "has no effect on game play"). Deck construction and format legality are per Oracle card.

column2: You may choose only a creature that's already on the battlefield and entered the battlefield this turn.
column3: Contradicts the card's Oracle text in part (template error; policy ruling-contradicting-oracle-gives-way, decided by the user Nov 5): the 2020-11-10 ruling limits the choice to "a creature", where the card copies "any permanent that entered this turn" ("You may have this creature enter as a copy of any permanent that entered this turn."), as its own same-day ruling about copying a planeswalker says. Likely origin: the Clone template "If [card] somehow enters the battlefield at the same time as another creature, it can't become a copy of that creature. You may choose only a creature that's already on the battlefield." (Progenitor Mimic 2013-04-15, Sakashima of a Thousand Faces the same day, and 20 more), with "and entered the battlefield this turn" added; the Commander Legends release notes (2020-11-06) print it so. Its first sentence, about a creature entering at the same time, stays cited.
